_note: SAMPLE posts for the mockup. Edit this file and redeploy GitHub Pages to publish an update (no app build needed). Newest first is not required; the app sorts by date. Give each post a unique id.

posts.title: Version 1.0.15 is out (sample)
posts.body: Smoother follow-me map while driving. New map keys for Flock cameras, gear hits and gear colors. The Android app now always uses its built-in scanner. The radio incidents layer was removed.

posts.title: Field testers wanted (sample)
posts.body: Near police and nothing shows on the map? Record a few minutes and send the file. See "Not seeing police on the map?" for the steps.
